title: Prepare the local chat helper
description: You read the request settings and response handling before the agent loop is built.
source: draft: codex free model + check fix: claude

steps.description: You import the request tools and name the local Ollama endpoint and model.
You define chat with a messages argument and a default temperature. The request sends those values with stream set to False, then returns the response's message content.

steps.question: What does chat return when the request or response handling raises an exception?
steps.answer: It prints the error and traceback, then returns an empty string.
